text:
Maya: Quick UX check: compact button variant (+icon) looks cramped in the new table action cell. Feels ~6px too tight horizontally.

Ethan: I noticed that too. On 1366x768 the icon overlaps the right divider when density=compact.

Ravi: Can you drop a screenshot? Also flagging that when the toast appears it sometimes sits under the modal backdrop (z-index problem).

Maya: Screenshot in thread. Toast repro: open dataset row actions -> click Bulk Edit -> submit -> toast appears but backdrop from the modal has higher z so toast is partially hidden. Happens on desktop only.

Lea: For buttons I think we should introduce a dedicated density token for action cells, e.g. --component-inline-gap: 10px. Current spacing tokens are generic and cause visual collisions when used inside tight table cells.

Maya: Agree. Proposed tokens: --btn-icon-gap: 8px; --table-action-gap: 10px; keep alias --space-2 -> --btn-icon-gap for one release.

Ethan: Code snippet for button spacing (quick):
```
.btn--compact { padding: 6px 8px; gap: var(--btn-icon-gap); }
.table-cell .action { gap: var(--table-action-gap); }
```

Ravi: For the toast z-index I'll add a rule: toasts use --z-toast: 9000 and modal backdrop is --z-backdrop: 8500. That way toasts float above backdrops but below modals themselves. We should validate with visual tests.

ContrastBot: Note: ghost/secondary buttons on blue header fail AA contrast on hover (text ratio ~3.8:1). Recommend increasing text weight or switching to inverted ghost on strong color surfaces.

Lea: Good catch. Options: 1) bold the ghost label on header surfaces; 2) add subtle white overlay behind ghost to lift it. Preference?

Maya: I vote for bold label + tokenized color: --ghost-on-strong: rgba(255,255,255,0.94). That will make intent explicit.

Ethan: I'll add a visual regression snapshot for header buttons and the compact table row at 3 breakpoints. Ravi: can you add the toast z-index test?

Ravi: Yup. I'll add Percy/Chromatic snapshots and a tiny unit test to ensure --z-toast > --z-backdrop.

Maya: Action items: Lea will draft token PR (btn-icon-gap, table-action-gap, ghost-on-strong). Ravi will fix z-index & add tests. Ethan will update snapshots. I'll follow up on the accessibility contrast change and file the a11y ticket.

Lea: Filing token PR in ~30m. Tagging the design token owners.

Maya: Thanks everyone :heart: Let's land token aliases for one release to avoid downstream breakage then flip usages in components after.
